annotations.annotation_text: Page 158 opens Book 1, Chapter 6 ("The Quiz Chapter") during the Age of Gods phase. This passage continues twelve questions and answers probing HCE's identity, the Mookse and the Gripes parable, Professor Jones, featuring Shem, Shaun, Professor Jones, the Mookse, the Gripes. The nocturnal dream-narrative layers Dublin topography, world mythology, and linguistic alchemy into polysemic prose.
